agents.name: adk_agent_builder
agents.description: Your guide to building agents with Google's Agent Development Kit. Get architecture advice, code examples, and best practices for single-agent and multi-agent systems — grounded in a curated library of ADK skills shipped with the agent.

useCases.title: Build From Scratch
useCases.description: Design and build ADK agents from scratch

useCases.title: Architecture Advice
useCases.description: Choose the right agent architecture (LlmAgent, Sequential, Parallel, Loop)

useCases.title: Tool Integration
useCases.description: Write function tools and integrate built-in or MCP tools

useCases.title: Prompts & Callbacks
useCases.description: Design system prompts and add callbacks / human-in-the-loop gates

useCases.title: Streaming
useCases.description: Build voice and video agents on the Gemini Live API

useCases.title: Skill Authoring
useCases.description: Create SKILL.md knowledge for your own agents

samplePrompts: Build me a simple agent that searches the web and summarizes results.
What's the best architecture for an agent that needs both code execution and web search?
How do I write a function tool that calls an external API and updates session state?
Show me how to add a human-in-the-loop approval step before a destructive action.
How should I structure a SKILL.md for my agent's domain knowledge?
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: data_analyst_agent
agents.description: Turn raw data into insights with statistical rigor. Upload a CSV, get exploratory analysis, ML-powered patterns, and publication-ready charts — every analysis ends with a structured Findings block (top insights, data quality flags, open questions) and inferential claims carry effect sizes and sample-size context.

useCases.title: Data Profiling
useCases.description: Explore and profile datasets — distributions, correlations, outliers — with quantified data-quality flags

useCases.title: Hypothesis Testing
useCases.description: Test group differences and relationships with proper test selection, effect sizes, and sample-size caveats

useCases.title: Segmentation
useCases.description: Segment customers or records with clustering, then characterize each cluster with profile statistics

useCases.title: Visualizations
useCases.description: Generate publication-ready charts (bar, scatter, heatmap, time series) with intentional chart selection

samplePrompts: Here's our Q1 sales CSV. Show me revenue trends by region and flag any anomalies.
Analyze this dataset: find the strongest predictors of churn and visualize the top 5.
Segment these 10K customers by behavior and describe each cluster.
Profile this dataset — show me data quality issues, distributions, and correlations.
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: deep_research_agent
agents.description: Autonomous multi-agent research pipeline. Decomposes a question into a plan, iteratively gathers evidence with Tavily, critiques coverage, and composes a fully cited markdown report — all in one turn.

useCases.title: Comparative Analysis
useCases.description: Side-by-side comparison reports across vendors, products, or technologies

useCases.title: Market Reports
useCases.description: Multi-angle market research with sourced statistics and trends

useCases.title: Technical Deep-Dives
useCases.description: In-depth technical investigations covering architecture, pricing, and adoption

useCases.title: Due Diligence
useCases.description: Background research on companies, frameworks, or claims with citation trails

samplePrompts: Compare Postgres logical vs physical replication for a 5-node cluster — operational complexity, failover behavior, and tooling maturity in 2026.
Research the state of right-to-repair legislation across the EU, US, and UK — which laws passed, what they cover, and how manufacturers are responding.
Investigate the post-RISC-V landscape: which silicon vendors shipped production chips in the last 18 months and where adoption stands beyond hobbyist boards.
Compile a brief on home solar + battery economics in Spain in 2026 — payback periods, regulatory shifts, and the state of community self-consumption schemes.
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: exa_mcp_agent
agents.description: Deep research across the web, code, companies, and people. Searches GitHub repos, crawls URLs, finds LinkedIn profiles, and generates comprehensive research reports with citations.

useCases.title: Company Research
useCases.description: Research companies — pricing, products, market position, leadership

useCases.title: Code Examples
useCases.description: Find code examples and documentation across GitHub and StackOverflow

useCases.title: Research Reports
useCases.description: Generate multi-source research reports on complex topics

useCases.title: People Search
useCases.description: Discover professionals and experts on LinkedIn

samplePrompts: Research Anthropic's current pricing, products, and recent launches — cite everything.
Find production examples of MCP server implementations in TypeScript on GitHub.
Start a deep research report on agentic AI adoption in enterprise, March 2026.
Find AI infrastructure engineers at Google DeepMind on LinkedIn.
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: google_explorer_agent
agents.description: Multi-step travel and local research. Plans trips, scouts neighborhoods, and recommends places — by chaining live Google Search with Google Maps in a single coordinated answer.

useCases.title: Trip Itineraries
useCases.description: Multi-day plans with neighborhoods, restaurants, and venues — sourced and mapped

useCases.title: Neighborhood Research
useCases.description: What's a place really like? Reviews, vibe, and concrete spots in one answer

useCases.title: Local Discovery
useCases.description: Find the best places for a specific need, with web context plus addresses, hours, and ratings

useCases.title: City Comparisons
useCases.description: Compare cities or neighborhoods across food, nightlife, safety, and points of interest

samplePrompts: Plan a 4-day Lisbon itinerary: coolest neighborhoods, one rooftop bar per night, vegan-friendly lunch each day.
Find top-rated vegan lunch spots in Bairro Alto, Lisbon — top 3 with hours and ratings.
Compare Tokyo's Shibuya vs Shinjuku for a first-time visitor and recommend a hotel area with concrete options.
What's the current vibe of Mexico City's Roma Norte in 2026, and which 5 cafés should I actually visit?
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: image_generation_agent
agents.description: Generate studio-quality images from natural language and refine them iteratively. Adjust lighting, composition, color, or remove elements while keeping the subject intact — like working with a creative director who never loses the brief.

useCases.title: Product Photography
useCases.description: Create product photography for e-commerce listings, then iterate on lighting and surfaces without losing the product

useCases.title: Hero Images
useCases.description: Design hero images for landing pages, then refine framing and color until the brief is nailed

useCases.title: Social Media Visuals
useCases.description: Generate social media visuals with scroll-stopping compositions and tweak them to match brand direction

useCases.title: Concept Iteration
useCases.description: Start with a rough concept and refine it conversationally — adjust mood, swap materials, change the time of day, all while preserving the subject

samplePrompts: Product hero shot of a matte black wireless earbud case on dark marble, studio rim lighting, 85mm lens, 1:1.
Editorial magazine cover: futuristic organic chair in a brutalist concrete hall, cinematic blue hour, 24mm wide-angle, 3:4.
Social media visual for a healthy snack brand: split-screen of fresh fruit vs packaged product, hyper-saturated, 9:16.
Scandinavian reading nook, sun-drenched, realistic wood and linen textures, soft window light, 35mm, eye-level.
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: mermaid_mcp_agent
agents.description: Create professional diagrams from plain language. Supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture maps, Gantt charts, C4 models, mindmaps, and more — rendered as high-quality images with editable code.

useCases.title: Process Mapping
useCases.description: Map business processes and decision trees for documentation

useCases.title: System Architecture
useCases.description: Design system architecture and microservice interactions

useCases.title: Project Timelines
useCases.description: Build project timelines and roadmap Gantt charts

useCases.title: Visual Models
useCases.description: Create org charts, user journeys, and state machines

samplePrompts: Flowchart for a SaaS signup: landing page → pricing → checkout → onboarding → activation loop.
Microservices architecture for an e-commerce platform: Auth, Catalog, Cart, Payments (Stripe), Fulfillment.
Gantt chart for a 6-month AI product roadmap: model selection, fine-tuning, beta, marketing, launch.
Sequence diagram showing OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE between client, auth server, and API.
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: repo_atlas_agent
agents.description: Map any public GitHub repository in seconds. Pass a URL and get a Mermaid diagram of the codebase structure plus a concise overview of purpose, stack, and entry points — all from the GitHub REST API, no cloning required.

useCases.title: Onboarding to a Codebase
useCases.description: Quick orientation to an unfamiliar repo before diving in

useCases.title: Architecture Documentation
useCases.description: Generate Mermaid diagrams to drop into READMEs or wikis

useCases.title: Tech Stack Audit
useCases.description: Identify language, framework, and key dependencies at a glance

useCases.title: Repo Triage
useCases.description: Decide whether a candidate library fits before cloning

samplePrompts: Map https://github.com/earendil-works/pi — how is this AI agent toolkit split across the coding-agent CLI, unified LLM API, and Slack bot?
Visualize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw — what are the components of this cross-platform personal AI assistant?
Generate a structural diagram for https://github.com/redis/redis — point out the core data-structure modules, the cluster layer, and the vector-query engine.
Give me an atlas of https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps — how are the 100+ AI agent and RAG apps organized in this collection?
agents.author: Albert Folch

agents.name: xquik_mcp_agent
agents.description: Connects ADK agents to Xquik MCP for X search, follower exports, monitors, webhooks, compose workflows, and giveaway draws.

useCases.title: Search X Posts
useCases.description: Find posts by keyword, account, or operator query.

useCases.title: Export Followers
useCases.description: Collect follower datasets for an account with pagination support.

useCases.title: Monitor Keywords
useCases.description: Create keyword monitors and route events to webhooks.

useCases.title: Run Giveaway Draws
useCases.description: Draw winners from post engagement with transparent filters.

samplePrompts: Search recent X posts about open source agent frameworks and summarize the strongest themes.
Extract followers for an account and return the first page as structured JSON.
Create a keyword monitor for a launch term and explain the webhook payload shape.
Run a giveaway draw from this post URL and describe the selected filters before execution.
agents.author: Xquik
